title: Use Geek Plus RMS Robot Selection screen to Add or Remove a robot by Robot ID
summary: Use the Geek Plus RMS web application Robot Selection screen to add (introduce) or remove a robot by entering its Robot ID (or selecting it from the list) and confirming the on-screen success message.
when_to_use: When support needs to introduce (add) or remove a robot in Geek Plus RMS during debug/support scenarios, using the Robot Selection screen’s Robot ID entry and Add/Remove actions.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Robot Selection Add/Remove actions in the Geek Plus RMS web application and verify the success confirmation messages.
safety_notes: If you remove a robot while it is physically present/active on the floor, it can create a mismatch between the logical robot in RMS and the physical robot; the source notes this as a problem scenario (robot removal can lead to obstacle/crash risk if the physical robot remains).
access_or_tools_needed: Geek Plus RMS web application access via OT network IP (local devices on OT net) or via authorized UPS VPN through Zscaler for remote support
Robot Selection screen in the Geek Plus RMS web application
Robot ID value(s) for the robot(s) being added/removed

access_required: Authorized access to Geek Plus RMS web application
system_preconditions: You can reach the Geek Plus RMS web application (OT network IP for on-site devices; remote requires authorization via UPS VPN through Zscaler).

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Add and Remove screen showing the Robot ID entry field and the Add/Remove mechanics (including partial numeric entry behavior).

steps.title: Open the Geek Plus RMS web application from the OT network
steps.purpose: Get to the Geek Plus RMS web application so you can access the Robot Selection screen.
steps.instruction: From a device connected on the OT network, open the Geek Plus RMS web application using the site’s IP address.
steps.expected_result: The Geek Plus RMS web application loads and you can navigate to the Robot Selection screen.
steps.healthy_condition: You can access the RMS web application through the OT network IP.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reach the Geek Plus RMS web application from the device you are using.

actions.label: Verify access path
actions.exact_action: Open the Geek Plus RMS web application from the OT network (any device connected on OT net can access the web application through its IP).

stop_or_escalate_if: If remote access is required and you cannot reach the Geek Plus RMS site, confirm you are authorized to use the UPS VPN through Zscaler and that you have the tenant ID/site authorization described in the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: As they are on OT net, any device connected on the OT network can access the web application through its IP; remote support requires authorization to use the UPS VPN through Z Scaler with tenant ID/site authorization.

steps.title: Locate the Robot ID input area on the Robot Selection screen
steps.purpose: Identify where to enter the Robot ID for add/remove actions.
steps.instruction: On the Robot Selection screen, find the Robot ID input area labeled for entering the corresponding robot ID.
steps.expected_result: The Robot ID field is visible and ready for entry.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Robot ID entry field on the Robot Selection screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the Robot ID entry field on the Robot Selection screen.

actions.label: Find Robot ID field
actions.exact_action: Locate the Robot ID input area labeled for entering the corresponding robot ID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Robot Selection Add and Remove: enter the corresponding robot ID (Robot ID entry field) and click Add/Remove.

steps.title: Add a robot by entering Robot ID and clicking Add
steps.purpose: Introduce a robot into Geek Plus RMS using its Robot ID.
steps.instruction: Enter the corresponding robot ID into the Robot ID field, then click the "Add" button.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection screen displays an adding success confirmation message indicating the robot was added successfully.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking Add, the system shows an "adding was successful" confirmation.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking Add, no adding success confirmation message appears.

actions.label: Enter Robot ID
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot ID into the Robot ID field.

actions.label: Click Add
actions.exact_action: Click "Add" button on the Robot Selection screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not show the documented success confirmation after clicking Add, stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To add a robot: enter the corresponding robot ID, click "Add" and verify "adding was successful".
Robot Selection Add and Remove: 1) Enter the corresponding robot ID 2) Click "Add" 3) The system will show that the adding was successful.

steps.title: Add using partial numeric entry when the robot is already introduced
steps.purpose: Quickly select the correct robot when it is already present in the system.
steps.instruction: If the robot is already introduced, use partial numeric entry (e.g., typing digits ending in 188) so matching robots appear, then use the matching robot entry.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection screen shows matching robot(s) based on the partial numeric entry (e.g., robots ending in 188).
steps.healthy_condition: Partial numeric entry results in matching robot(s) being shown for selection.
steps.failure_condition: Partial numeric entry does not produce matching robot(s) to select.

actions.label: Enter partial digits
actions.exact_action: If it's already been introduced, you can just do 188 (partial ending digits) so the ones ending in 188 appear.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Partial numeric entry can show robots already introduced (e.g., ones ending in 188).
If it's already been introduced, you can just do 188 so they show the ones ending in 188.

steps.title: Remove a robot by entering Robot ID or selecting it, then clicking Remove
steps.purpose: Remove a robot from Geek Plus RMS using its Robot ID.
steps.instruction: To remove a robot, enter the corresponding robot ID into the Robot ID field or select the robot from the list, then click the "Remove" button.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection screen displays a removal success confirmation message indicating the robot removal was successful.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking Remove, the system shows a "removal was successful" confirmation.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking Remove, no removal success confirmation message appears.

actions.label: Enter Robot ID or select robot
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot.

actions.label: Click Remove
actions.exact_action: Click "Remove" button on the Robot Selection screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not show the documented success confirmation after clicking Remove, stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To remove a robot: enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot, click "Remove" and verify "removal was successful".
Robot Selection Add and Remove: Remove Robot: 1) Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot 2) Click "Remove" 3) The system will show that the removal was successful.

success_criteria: After clicking Add, the Robot Selection screen shows an adding success confirmation message.
After clicking Remove, the Robot Selection screen shows a removal success confirmation message.
healthy_conditions: Robot ID entry field is available on the Robot Selection screen.
Success confirmations appear immediately after Add/Remove actions.
failure_conditions: No adding success confirmation after clicking Add.
No removal success confirmation after clicking Remove.
escalation_guidance: If the system does not show the documented success confirmation after clicking Add or Remove, stop and escalate for support (the source provides success-confirmation behavior but does not specify error-handling steps).

If remote access is required and you cannot reach the Geek Plus RMS site, confirm you are authorized to use the UPS VPN through Zscaler and that you have the tenant ID/site authorization described in the source.
